system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant for Slack workspace tasks.

scenarios.name: S1
scenarios.description: Create a private project channel, invite members, set details, and post a welcome.

prompts.prompt_text: Hi, I'm Ethan (id: U985OUO9ZYKT), team lead for the new 'rideshare' project. Please create a new private channel for project 'rideshare' with the name 'project-rideshare', add William (id: UJJNWQVLHQS9) and Noah (id: UG7I699IBCTE), set its topic and purpose accordingly, and post the message “Hi, welcome all @here” for me.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM slack_channels WHERE name = 'project-rideshare' AND members LIKE '%U985OUO9ZYKT%' AND members LIKE '%UJJNWQVLHQS9%' AND members LIKE '%UG7I699IBCTE%'
